nuggets.text: The Bills' new Highmark Stadium seats 60,108, the smallest seated capacity of any NFL venue.
Seats above the north end zone of the Bills' new stadium sit as close as 12 feet vertically from the field.
The Bills opened their new Highmark Stadium with a 29-14 preseason win over the Panthers on August 15.
Bills coach Joe Brady won the Broyles Award as college football's top assistant in 2019 at LSU.
Joe Brady's 'Everybody Eats' offense had a league-record 13 players score receiving touchdowns for the Bills in 2024.
James Cook led the NFL with 1,621 rushing yards in 2025, the first Bill to win the rushing title since 1976.
James Cook is the younger brother of fellow NFL running back Dalvin Cook.
The Bills' last win in Houston came in 2006, on a J.P. Losman touchdown pass to Peerless Price with nine seconds left.
The Bills are the only NFL team that plays its home games in the state of New York.
Josh Allen holds the NFL record for career rushing touchdowns by a quarterback.
